name: What is the typical process for functional layout improvements with Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for functional layout improvements with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to understand your needs and vision. We then conduct a site visit to assess your existing space and gather detailed measurements. Based on this, we develop design concepts and floor plans for your review and approval. Once the design is finalized, we handle all necessary permits, material procurement, and construction, keeping you informed throughout the project. Our goal is to ensure a smooth and efficient transformation of your space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process includes consultation, site assessment, design, permitting, and construction, with client involvement at each stage.
